subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should ambient room_event runs use a session-stable prompt/tool contract, including stable owner-only Gateway tool inventory across sender owner/non-owner flips, while keeping effective visible delivery message-tool-only?
rationale: The cache-stability repair is concrete, but exposing or hiding owner-only tool schemas for ambient room events is a product/security-boundary policy choice that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
options.body: Review and land the linked candidate after confirming the stable prompt-facing mode and ambient tool-inventory policy are the desired contract.

options.title: Revise Tool-Inventory Policy
options.body: Ask the candidate PR to keep a different owner/non-owner inventory boundary and accept a narrower cache-stability fix.

options.title: Document Strict Behavior Only
options.body: Reject the runtime change and document the prompt-cache tradeoff as part of the ambient room-event contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked candidate after confirming the stable prompt-facing mode and ambient tool-inventory policy are the desired contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room policy history in the merged group visible-reply work.
